items.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09

ctx.x: I don't know whether it's the water or what it is, but you just can't, they just don't have the same taste out there, the red beans. We used to get them sent out, and they call them a different kind of bean out there. Yeah. Uh-huh. It's not the red, but my wife, Beverly, we would try to cook them, but I think it's just the atmosphere in New Orleans, too, that the red beans stays good. You know, uh... With the French bread.
I see them from the north, and we used to buy red beans, just red beans. And here in New Orleans, all I can find is red kidney beans.
